name: pypi-pep621-pyproject-only
note: a modern PEP 621 package with no setup.py and a standard out-of-tree build backend (setuptools.build_meta). No backend-path, so inspectPyprojectBuild must NOT fire. False-block guard for the pyproject path.

sourceFiles.pyproject.toml:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "confparse"
version = "0.4.2"
description = "tiny config parser"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.9"
dependencies = ["tomli; python_version < '3.11'"]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/confparse/confparse"
